svg.title: The evolution of software worlds
svg.desc: Three click-controlled eras: a slowly spinning gas giant whose cloud bands carry a dense web of modules and dependencies, then smaller spinning rocky service planets whose modules are mountains, connected by asteroid belts, then the same planets swelling into volcanic worlds whose mountains have become volcanoes while unexpected new services appear.

g.text: In the beginning, there was the monolith.
One deployment. An entire world of dependencies.
Smaller worlds. Simpler surfaces. More connections.
Worlds grow. New ones appear. Pressure builds.
